note: The same refusal in the partition conversion: native families 5 and 7 each deliver the case twins Kon and KON in different years, so `1.5.kon` and `1.7.kon` bind as split declarations, and both are pinned `kon`. The partition conversion refuses both, each located at its [[variable]] entry, and the tag naming `scb/sample/kon` is withheld with both identities' source refs, as in step 1.
fails_if: `compile_partitions` (curation_compile.py) stops carrying its conversion's refused declarations into `refused_naming`, so the tag member is reported `catalog_dependency_missing` and the build aborts

sources.description: Variables 5 and 7 each deliver Kon in 2020 and KON in 2021 (CVIDs 20/21 and 30/31).
